rule: Validate and normalize the whole request body at the API boundary with an allow-list of fields, types and ranges before it reaches business logic; report every field error.
good_example: const { value, errors } = validateGpaRequest(req.body); if (errors.length) return sendError(res, 400, 'INVALID_INPUT', errors);
provenance: C3 research team reviewed card (2026-10-20); paraphrases OWASP Input Validation Cheat Sheet
